name: AI agents this week
topic: AI agents: software that acts on its own with language models, the products that ship them, the research, the security incidents and the businesses around them
audience: developers and product people who build with or buy AI agents

rubric.counts_as_news: agent products and model releases, acquisitions and funding, research results, security incidents involving agents, regulation, and customer results with numbers
rubric.leave_out: event promotions, webinars, listicles, and a vendor's own marketing with no news in it
